from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for col in range(width):
        markers = [r for r in range(height) if grid[r][col] == 5]
        if not markers:
            continue
        bottom = max(markers)
        color = None
        for r in range(bottom, -1, -1):
            if grid[r][col] != 0:
                color = grid[r][col]
            elif color is not None:
                out[r][col] = color
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-5b8e98f4.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path, path.read_text())
